description: Download public Pinterest images and videos with the Pin metadata users need to identify each file. Provide links or search words.

commerceOnly.description: Keep only Pins with source-backed shopping metadata.
commerceOnly.title: Shoppable Pins only

cookies.description: Optional Cookie Editor JSON export. The downloader works without cookies; never share this secret publicly.
cookies.title: Optional Pinterest cookies

cookiesJson.description: Compatibility alias for pasting a Cookie Editor JSON export.
cookiesJson.title: Optional cookies JSON (alias)

excludeAds.description: Exclude Pins Pinterest marks as promoted.
excludeAds.title: Exclude promoted Pins

includeComments.description: When enabled, add real comment/activity rows for every Pin whose media is processed. The public cookieless path is used automatically.
includeComments.title: Include Pin comments

maxComments.description: Maximum public comment/activity rows to add per Pin when comments are enabled.
maxComments.title: Maximum comments per Pin

maxItems.description: Maximum number of media items to download per search term. Set to 0 for unlimited.
maxItems.title: Max Items

minCreatorFollowers.description: Keep media only when Pinterest supplies this creator follower count.
minCreatorFollowers.title: Minimum creator followers

minSaves.description: Keep media only when Pinterest supplies at least this many saves.
minSaves.title: Minimum saves

mode.description: Use direct Pin links, search words, or auto-detect both.
mode.title: What to download

pinterestUrls.description: List of Pinterest pin URLs to download media from (e.g. https://www.pinterest.com/pin/123456789/).
pinterestUrls.title: Pinterest URLs

proxy.description: Optional proxy settings. Not required — works without proxy from datacenter IPs.
proxy.title: Proxy Configuration

requireOutboundLink.description: Keep only Pins with a public destination URL.
requireOutboundLink.title: Require destination link

searchTerms.description: List of keywords to search on Pinterest. All media (images and videos) from search results will be downloaded.
searchTerms.title: Search Terms

verifiedOnly.description: Keep only media whose creator is explicitly verified by Pinterest.
verifiedOnly.title: Verified creators only

title: Pinterest Media Downloader Input
